schema: SeaSick harpoon rope look v1 (phase 0, docs/PLAN-harpoon.md). For a Unity LineRenderer with sag; colours are sRGB hex tints that MULTIPLY the rope tile.
retune_2026_10_04: Taut read dull olive and the strained glow was faked. Causes: (1) the tint MULTIPLIES a tan tile (mean sRGB 157,120,68), so a cream tint only darkens it; (2) a LineRenderer without generateLightingData has no normals, so the toon shader (SeaSick/Environment Toon Textured) lands in its lowest cel band under bluish SH ambient = olive; (3) that shader has no emission colour: its emission is _Ambient (added to the light, x albedo, 0..1; flames and pier glows use it). Fix: white taut tint (the tile's own straw) + an _Ambient floor, slack darker, strained orange-red with _Ambient pulsing. Top-level *Width/*Color keys are what Ship/Harpoon/HarpoonLine.cs reads; states.* keep the full spec.

material.name: SS_Harpoon_Rope
material.texture: Assets/_Project/Art/WallL1/Textures/rope-tile-512.png (same tile as the packed V3_rope-tile-512.png in harpoon-v1.blend; already used by SS_WallL1_Rope / SS_StorageL1_Hemp)
material.shader: SeaSick/Environment Toon Textured (SS_Harpoon_Rope): albedo = tile x vertex colour x _BaseColor; its only emission is _Ambient (0..1, x albedo). Drive _Ambient per line with a MaterialPropertyBlock: states.*.ambient, strained pulsing.

readability.note: 0.075 m at ~40 m from the phone-high camera is ~4-5 px on a 1080x2340 portrait screen. Keep at least minScreenWidthPx by widening with camera distance.

slack.note: dull dark hemp (tile x tan = sRGB ~135,94,38), visible belly; rests a hand above the water

taut.note: bright straw: the tile's own colour lifted by the 0.35 floor (~sRGB 210,160,90 in daylight), almost straight

strained.note: warm orange-red (tile x tint = sRGB ~157,50,13) glowing: _Ambient pulses 0.5..1.0 at pulseHz (the glow is the rope's own orange); small width jitter; dead straight

blend: Lerp tint/width/sag by tension: slack (t<=0.3) -> taut (t=0.7) -> strained (t>=0.9). No step changes (the plan's ease rule). Lerp ambient the same way (slack 0.08 -> taut 0.35 -> strained 0.5..1.0 pulse).

drumCoil.note: fat static coils that spin with Winch_Drum (local X); one coil diameter 0.09 m reads as rope at phone size. Spin while reeling, opposite while paying out.
